subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this PR wait for redacted real Gateway/remote embedding outage recovery proof, or should a maintainer explicitly accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as a proof override?
rationale: This is an external PR and the current proof is mock-boundary test output; automation cannot decide to waive the real-behavior proof gate for provider fallback behavior.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic manager-level regression as sufficient because it exercises the same MemoryIndexManager recovery path, while owning the live-provider proof gap.

options.title: Maintainer-run proof
options.body: A memory-core owner can run the Gateway/provider outage scenario themselves and post the redacted proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for this memory provider-state boundary is the memory engine/plugin and provider-state refactor history.
